messages.subject: spin(): width of kable tables
parts:
I'm trying to have a simple but readable table in html using spin().
I have

x <- sample(1:7,10,replace=TRUE)
y <- sample(c("A","B"),10,replace=TRUE)
kable(table(x,y),row.names=TRUE)

The console output would be enough:
|   |  A|  B|
|:--|--:|--:|
|1  |  0|  1|
|2  |  1|  1|
|3  |  0|  1|
|4  |  0|  2|
|5  |  0|  2|
|6  |  0|  1|
|7  |  0|  1|

but after running spin(), the html produced from the *.md file has a formatted
table that is as wide as the page and thus with too wide columns.

I've tried different combinations such as
#+ results='asis'
x <- sample(1:7,10,replace=TRUE)
y <- sample(c("A","B"),10,replace=TRUE)
kable(table(x,y),row.names=TRUE, format='html')

but always get the same. Is there any way to get a more reasonable width?
Alternatively, just reproducing the output of the console would be enough

(I'm aware of more complicated solutions involving css files, but want something really simple, even if the result is a bit crude)

Thanks
Agus
